title: X-Scene: Large-Scale Driving Scene Generation with High Fidelity and Flexible Controllability

output_modality.value: 3D semantic occupancy, multi-view images and videos, lifted to 3DGS; extended to large scenes by consistency-aware outpainting

control_signal.value: low level: BEV semantic or vector layout, 3D boxes, camera; high level: text description, LLM-enriched into a scene graph then converted to a vector-map layout

control_mechanism.value: Occupancy triplane diffusion: additive layout embedding plus cross-attention on box and text embeddings; images: occupancy-rendered semantic and depth maps fused with noisy latents plus cross-attention; video: reference frames

base_model.value: Triplane VAE with deformable attention and latent diffusion for occupancy; image diffusion; temporal diffusion; T5 text encoder; scene-graph-to-layout diffusion; 3D Gaussian splatting

datasets.value: Occ3D-nuScenes for occupancy, nuScenes for images and video; 700 train and 150 val scenes; frames upsampled from 2 Hz to 12 Hz

metrics.value: occupancy IoU, mIoU, FID3D, 2D FID, KID, IS; image FID; FVD; downstream 3D detection mAP and NDS, BEV segmentation mIoU, UniAD planning L2 and collision

controllability_evidence.value: Real plus X-Scene data gives detection mAP 39.9 and NDS 51.6 vs 34.5 and 46.9 real only; an ablation reports FID up 9.45 and vehicle mIoU down 22.27% without spatial conditioning

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop only: UniAD planning metrics on generated video, autoregressive 7-frame clips with two reference frames

stated_limitations.value: Autoregressive video drifts over long horizons; memory bank built only from nuScenes limits diversity; fixed semantic categories need retraining for new classes

notes: Scene generator, not action-conditioned; no ego-action control. Which ablation the 9.45 and 22.27% figures refer to is inferred from context.
